bit_string_types.name: source_port
bit_string_types.description: Source Port is an optional field, when meaningful, it indicates the port of the sending process, and may be assumed to be the port to which a reply should be addressed in the absence of any other information.

bit_string_types.name: length
bit_string_types.description: Length is a field in the UDP header that indicates the total length of the datagram including header and data.

bit_string_types.name: checksum
bit_string_types.description: Checksum is a 16-bit one's complement sum of a pseudo header and the payload.
